description: You win when no Mafia, Cult, or Hostile Independents remain.
If killed, you will survive and start "Bleeding".
Players who are "Bleeding" will die during the next night.
You are revealed to all players.
Each night, you will block the night actions of any players who visit you.
You start with a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
Your starting Gun never reveal you when used.
Each night, you will announce who visits you.
Each night, you will announce any system messages you received.
You start the game "Leaky".
Players who are "Leaky" will have all whispers involving them leak.
You see self as Villager.
You appear as a random evil role in the setup to information roles, and when condemned.
You appear as Miller when killed.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Miller will learn a fake word.

description: Once per game during the day, you can choose to host a party at night.
During a party all players can chat.
Once per game at night, you can choose to grow into a Tree.
Trees are immune to most ways of dying.
Trees cannot vote.
You start with a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
Your starting Gun always reveals you when used.
Each night, you randomly visit one player.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Sleepwalker will learn a fake word.

description: Each night, you can choose to visit two players and protect them from death.
One of the players you protect will become “Delirious” until the next night.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and protect them from death.
If a player you protect is attacked, you will kill one attacker and die.

Celebrity: If a Bodyguard is Protecting a Celebrity, the Bodyguard will kill all attackers and die.

description: Each night, you can choose to visit one player and protect them from death.
See also: Quack (Mafia), Witch Doctor (Cult).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and protect them from being condemned the following day.
If the player you protect is condemned, you die.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players.
If the first player you visit dies, the second player you visit will gain an extra life.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and remove any malicious effects they have.
Malicious effects include poison, bleeding, insanity, polarization, gasoline, anesthetic gas, lovesick, zombification, alcoholism, lycanthropy, and viruses.
Each night, you can choose to visit one dead player and revive them.
See also: Graverobber (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and prevent them from being converted to another role.
If you visit a Hostile Independent, the Hostile Independent will be converted to Villager.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and protect them from death.
If a player you protect is attacked, you will kill one attacker.
If both of your neighbors are not Evil, they cannot die.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them Coffee.
Coffee can be used at night to perform their role's actions an additional time.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and give them Bread.
Bread is consumed during a famine to prevent death.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them Armor.
Armor will protect its holder from one attack.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Candle.
A Candle will tell its holder who visited them during the night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Knife.
A Knife can be used during the day to make a player start "Bleeding".
Players who are "Bleeding" will die during the next night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Bomb.
If a Bomb's holder is killed, their killer is killed.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Falcon.
A Falcon can be used at night to learn who a player visits.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Gun.
Each night, each player who visits you will be given a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Crystal Ball.
Crystal Ball allows its holder to select a player each night. If the holder dies, the last selected player will be revealed.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
See also: Gunrunner (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Key.
A Key can be used at night to block the actions of anyone visits its holder.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Shield.
If possible, A Shield will protect its holder from one attack by redirecting it to another player who is not the attacker.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them an Envelope.
An Envelope can be used at anytime to send a message to a player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Tract.
A Tract will prevent its holder from being converted one time.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Whiskey.
Whiskey can be used during the day to block a player's actions next night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Syringe.
A Syringe can be used during the day to revive a dead player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Rifle.

A Rifle can be used during the day to kill a player. If a Rifle kills a player of same alignment as its holder, its holder dies. If a "Rifle" kills a player of different alignment to its holder, its holder is given a Rifle at the end of the day.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Jack-In-The-Box.
A Jack-In-The-Box can be used at night to gain the abilites of a Village-aligned Banished role until the next night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn if they are naughty or nice.
If another player visits you during the night, you will learn nothing.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them an item.
You can choose to give a Gun, Knife, Armor, Bomb, Crystal Ball, Whiskey, Bread, Key, Falcon, Tract, Syringe, or Coffee.
You will not start with any items.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them any items you would have started with.
On your first day, you can make up to five guesses in chat following this structure: "I will analyze if (Player Name) is (Role Name)".
You will learn how many guesses were correct during the night.
On your first night, you learn how many instances of two evil players neighboring each other there are.
At the start of each night, learn how many players in the most recent vote appeared evil.
On your first night, you learn an evil player.
When the player you learned dies, you will learn another evil player at night.
One Village-aligned role becomes an Evil-aligned and wins if Village loses.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and learn how many of them visited anybody or received reports.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn if they are guilty or innocent.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn their alignment.
Each night, you can choose to visit one dead player and learn their role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn their role.
See also: Stalker (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what modifiers are on their role.
Each night, you learn how many of your neighbors are evil.
Each night, you learn if an evil player voted with the majority on the previous day.
If the vote was tied, you learn a random value.
Each night, you learn how many pieces of false information were created.

Journalist: Forensicist will not count Journalist information.

description: On your first night, you learn the distance in players between 2 Evil players.
If the distance is 0, then the evil players are neighboring each other.
On your first night, you learn if the closest evil player is above you or below you on the player list.
This will loop around at the top and bottom of the player list.
Each night, you learn how many dead players are Evil.
Each night, you learn the role of the most recently condemned player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn two roles, one of which is their role.
The two roles will always be from opposite alignments.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what reports they received.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and learn if they are the same alignment.
On your first night, you learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular role.
On your first night, you learn about 3 players. 1 will be Evil, 2 will be good.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and learn if one of them is Mafia or Demonic.
Each Day, you can choose to learn if a player is, neighbors, was visited by, or visited a role.
Each night, you can choose to reveal 1-3 Excess roles to all players.
Each night, you choose a role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn if their role is the selected role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one dead player and learn all system messages they ever received.
Each night, you can choose to learn a random player's role or two excess roles.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn two roles that are not their role.
Each day, you can choose to learn two pieces of information about the game. One will be true and one will be false.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what items they are holding.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn who they visited.
See also: Scout (Mafia).

Each night, choose a player to tutor. If they are Village aligned, they will temporarily become a random Information role for the rest of that night and the following day. They will be informed of their new role at the start of day. You receive no feedback on your action.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what roles visited them.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn who visited them.
See also: Lookout (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player dies, you will learn that the killer is 1 of 2 players.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player dies, you will gain that player's abilities.
See also: Blackguard (Mafia), Yith (Cult).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player dies, you will gain a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and if they didn't visit anybody, have them learn 3 players, at least one of whom is Evil.
You cannot choose to visit the same player consecutively (unless roleblocked).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and if they didn't visit anybody, have them learn 3 roles and a player who is one of the roles.
You cannot choose to visit the same player consecutively.
Each night, you can choose to visit one dead player and exorcise them.
Exorcised players can't be revived or use graveyard abilities.
See also: Ghostbuster (Mafia).
Once per game at night, you can choose a role.
Any players with the selected role will become "Delirious" for 3 Nights and 3 Days.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and block their night actions.
See also: Hooker (Mafia).
You cannot die.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Delirious" until the next night.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
See also: Pimp (Mafia), Succubus (Cult).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and swap roles with them.
You can only swap roles once.
The swap happens before other night actions. You and the player you swapped with use the new roles that same night.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and make them swap roles.
The swap happens before other night actions, and the swapped players use their new roles that same night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and block the night actions of each player who visit them.
See also: Bouncer (Mafia).
Each night, you fix any broken or corrupted items you are holding.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and fix any broken or corrupted items they are holding.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player's role is Village-aligned, you will be converted to their role and they will be converted to Villager.
If that player's role is Mafia-aligned, you will be converted to Villager.
If that player's role is Cult-aligned or Independent-aligned, you will be converted to Amnesiac.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and remove modifiers from their role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and add a random modifier to their role.
Cannot add Exclusive, Clannish, Inclusive, or Starting Item modifiers.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and reveal their role to all players.
Each night, you can choose a role and you will appear as that role on death and to information roles.
Cannot choose Villager, Impersonator or Imposter
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them learn that you are the Vegan.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If you die, that player's role will be revealed to all players.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and tell them a secret.
The secret will be about Visits, Visitors, or Items.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and give the first player's items to the second player.
If the second player is mafia, items will not be transfered.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
Town roles with the Humble modifier and a night meeting appear as this role to self.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and steal an item from them.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
The following day, that player can choose to reveal their role or reveal your role.
After someone reveals your role, you will be unable to use your night action.
If you die, an Evil player will be given Shaving Cream.
Shaving Cream can be used at night to make two selected players swap roles but not alignments. A switch fails if one of the players is an Independent role.
If you die, all players are converted to the role they had at the start of the game.
Each night when dead, a Banished Event will occur.
If you are condemned, you can choose a player to kill.
If you die, all players will be "Blind" during the following Day.
Players who are "Blind" will see all speech as anonymous and cannot see votes.
If you die, all Village-aligned players will be converted to Villager.
If killed at night, players are forced to vote for no one the next day.
If you die, all other Sheep die.
Adds 1 Sheep in closed setups.
If killed by the Mafia, you will survive and be converted to Traitor.
If you die, all players will be "Purblind" during the following Day.
Players who are "Purblind" cannot see votes.
If you are condemned, no one can die the following night.

Hooker: If a Hooker blocks a Virgin, The Virgin is converted to Villager.

description: Once per game during the day when dead, you must choose a player.
If that player is village aligned, they will die during the night.
Your vote weight is worth 2 votes.
See also: Prosecutor (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them your master.
Your vote only counts if you are voting the same target as your master.
Once per game at dusk, you can choose to change the target of a condemnation.
You cannot change the target to no one.
Choosing no one or the original target preserves your override ability.
Your vote weight is worth 10000 votes.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Sceptre.
A Sceptre can be used during the day to gain 10000 voting power.
All votes for whoever you are voting for do not count.
If less then 4 players are able to vote, you have no ability.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and prevent them from voting and from being voted.
If a player is condemned, all players are Delirious that night.

Assassin: If an Assassin is Present, All players are Delirious if an Evil player is Elected as Room Leader.

description: The first player to vote for you is condemned and ends the day.
Once per game during the day, you can force the next night phase to skip and two day phases to occur consecutively.
Each day, one Evil player will be given a chance to guess who you are.
If you are correctly guessed, the day ends and you are condemned.
If an incorrect guess is made, no one will get to guess you the following day.
You see yourself as a random non-Banished Village role from the setup.
You have that role's abilities but you are "Delirious".
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
If you stop being "Delirious", you will become "Delirious" the next night.
Each night, you break any items you are holding.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Braggart will learn a fake word.

description: Each night, you can choose to visit one player and redirect anyone who visits you to that player.
See also: Rat (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and swap their visitors.
Players who visit first player will be redirected to second player.
Players who visit second player will be redirected to first player.
See also: Driver (Mafia).
You see yourself as a random Demonic Cult role from the setup.
You can use fake versions of that role's abilities.
You will attend a Fake Cult Meeting with the non-Demonic Cult roles.
Cult players will learn who you select at night.
Each night, you can choose a player and gain their abilities until the next night.
Once per game at night, you can choose Village-aligned role from the setup.
You will be converted to the chosen role.
This choice happens before other night actions, and you use the new role that same night.
If another player is that role, that player will become "Delirious" until you die.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
Each night, you can choose a banished Village role and gains its abilities until the next night.
You have the abilities of up to 5 banished Village roles.
You cannot have the Hermit ability.
Each night, you give a random player a random item.
The item has a 50% chance to be broken.
Cursed items will misfire or be otherwise ineffective.
You meets with other Capybaras at night.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them an Orange.
An Orange can be used during the day to meet with Capybaras at night. When meeting with Capybaras no night actions can be performed.
Each day, you can choose two players and have them attend a banquet at night together.
When attending a banquet they will learn each other's roles and cannot perform night actions.
You meet with other Freemasons at night.
Each night, all Freemasons can choose to visit one player and convert them to Freemason.
All Freemasons die if they attempt to convert a member of the Mafia or Demonic.
Cult-aligned roles will not be converted.

Serial Killer: All Freemasons die if they attempt to convert a Serial Killer.
Cult Leader: Cultists and Cult Leaders will die if targeted by Freemasons.
Cultist: Cultists and Cult Leaders will die if targeted by Freemasons.

description: Each day, you can choose one player and observe any night chats they are in.
Each night, each player who visits you will be invited to the common room.
Players invited to the common will meet with you the following night.
You meet with other Templars at night.
Adds 1 Templar in closed setups.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Templar will not learn any words.
Spymaster: If a Spymaster is Present, acts as Tristan/Isolde with mutual knowledge and no guess-loss epilogue.

description: Each night, each player who visits you will have any malicious effects they have removed and will be protected from death.
Players who Role Share with you will have any malicious effects they have removed.
Malicious effects include poison, bleeding, insanity, polarization, gasoline, anesthetic gas, lovesick, zombification, alcoholism, lycanthropy, and viruses.
See also: Dealer (Mafia).
Each night, if no one visits you, you will learn about 3 players, at least one of whom is Evil; or 1 player who is Village aligned.
Each night, each player who visits you will be given Bread.
Bread is consumed during a famine to prevent death.
If you die, all players who ever visited you will be announced.
Each night, you learn what roles visited you.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Doused".
Once per game during the day, you can choose to kill all players that are "Doused".
Each night, each player who visits you will be killed.
You cannot be converted.
You can only be killed by condemn.
Each dusk, if no one was condemned, you can choose to jail a player during the night.
The jailed player cannot perform night actions.
You will block the night actions of any players who visit the jailed player.
You will meet anonymously with the jailed player.
You can choose to kill the jailed player.
See also: Interrogator (Mafia).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them if their role is Hider or Invader.
Forces a Hider or Invader to Spawn in closed Setups.
During the day, you choose a Player role Relation to Test.
If the Relation is True, you kill a Random Village or Independent Aligned Player at Night.
You can kill yourself.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill one player who visits them.
Preferentially kills Mafia, Cult, Independents, then Villagers.
Other players who visit the chosen player will learn that you are a Trapper.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them.
You can anonymously contact any non-Village role during the day.
Each day, you can choose a dead player.
You will meet anonymously with the chosen player at night.
Each day, you can ask a question.
Dead players can answer the question the following night with yes or no.
You will learn the results of the vote.
You can anonymously broadcast messages during the day.
You are revealed to all players.
Your vote weight is worth 10000 votes.
All other players will start as Grouch.
You start with a Chest containing 15 Gold and Village/Independent roles from the setup.
You will take 1-5 of Gold from the Chest and give it to the player below you.
The player below you can choose to remove a role from the Chest.
Then starting with the player below you, each player will choose to become a role in the Chest or steal Gold from the Chest to become an Evil role.
If no roles or Gold remain in the Chest, a player will remain as Grouch.
The player above you can choose to remain as Grouch even if Gold or roles remain in the Chest.
If 2 or more non-evil roles are condemned, all Village-aligned players die.
Once per game during the day when dead, you must choose a player.
If that player is not village aligned, all Village-aligned players die.
When the game ends, the winners and losers are switched.
If Multiple Brokers are in a game, the winners and losers can swapped multiple times.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and convert them to a random non-banished Village role if their role is Statue.
Forces a Statue to spawn in closed setups.
If the first Evil Player to say "I think the Statue is (Player Name)" during the day is correct, Mafia and Cult win.
All Mafia and Cult players learn if a Statue is in the game.
All village aligned players will know that you are the President.
If you die, the Mafia/Cult will win.

Assassin: If an Assassin is Present, village aligned Players will not learn who the President is.

description: If you are condemned, all players who are aligned with you die.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Saint will not learn any words.

description: You know which players are Mafia and Cult.
When condemned, Mafia and Cult have a chance to guess who you are.
On a correct guess, you die and the Mafia or Cult wins.
You appear as Villager when killed.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Seer will not learn any words.
Spymaster: If a Spymaster is Present, you learn evil players at game start (like Merlin). Godfather and Cultist (Respected) stay hidden.
Charlatan: Charlatan appears as Seer to a Retired Seer.

description: You are assigned a Mafia or Cult role in addition to the Mole role
You will appear as that role and have that role's abilities but will still win with Village.
You will count towards Mafia/Cult majority and attend their meetings.
Once per game, at night Mafia/Cult can guess who you are even if dead.
On a correct guess, Mafia/Cult wins.
You will still be the Mole even if converted.
If more then half of the Senators in play die, Mafia/Cult wins.
Adds 2 to 4 Senators in closed setups.
If the number of living Soldiers equals half of all living players, the Village wins.
Your team cannot win if you fail to role share with any Presidents, Senators, and Vital Village roles in the game.
Adds a President in closed setups.
At the end of the day, if exactly three players are alive and no player was condemned today, the game ends and your team wins.
You are randomly assigned another player as a target.
Each night, you learn who your target visits and is visited by.
Once per game during the day, you can learn who your target is but you will no longer learn over information.
Each day, you can choose to open the door.
When you open the door all players will learn that a Mistress opened the door.
When the door is opened, you will learn an evil player.
If the door was opened, you will die at night unless visited by a Village-aligned player.
Each day, you can choose to go trick or treating.
All evils players will learn if you go trick or treating.
At night if trick or treating, you will announce who visits your neighbors.
Each day, you can choose one player and propose to them.
That player has to publicly accept or deny the proposal.
If that player accepts, the player and you will be revealed to all players.
Once a proposal is accepted, you cannot make another proposal.
Before the game starts, you are replaced with a random Banished Village role.
You win when the Mafia has a majority.
You appear as Villager to information roles.

Ghost: If a Ghost is Present, a Godfather will learn the real word.
Spymaster: If a Spymaster is Present, acts as Mordred and stays hidden from the Seer's opening reveal.

description: Each night, you learn the role of each player who visits you.
Your vote weight is worth 2 votes.
See also: Attorney (Village).
You start with a Gun.
A Gun can be used during the day to kill a player.
Your starting Gun never reveal you when used.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Doused".
Once per game during the day, you can choose to kill all players that are "Doused".
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them if a non-Mafia player visits them.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Woozy".
Players who are "Woozy" will die during the next night if they visit another player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them if their role is Seeker or Invader.
Forces a Seeker or Invader to Spawn in closed Setups.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them.
Each night, you can choose a word.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and "Jinx" them with the chosen word for the following day.
Players who are "Jinxed" with a word, will die if they say that word.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and "Poison" them
Players who are "Poisoned" will die during the next night.
If you are the only Mafia-aligned player alive at the start of the day, you will start a beheading.
During a beheading, if you are alive at the end of the day, all non-Mafia players die.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill one player who visits them.
Other players who visit the chosen player will learn that you are a Rottweiler.
Once per game during the day, you can choose to kill yourself and another player.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn their role.
You will appear as that player's role when you die and to information roles.
Each night, you choose a role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn if their role is the selected role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what roles visited them.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn what reports they received.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn who visited them.
See also: Watcher (Village).
Each night, you can choose to visit one dead player and learn all system messages they ever received.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn who they visited.
See also: Tracker (Village).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn their role.
See also: Detective (Village).
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player is the first to speak or vote the following day, that player's role is revealed to the Mafia.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and block their night actions.
See also: Drunk (Village).
Gain 2 Gold whenever a Village-aligned player is killed or condemned.
Each day, a shop opens with 3 randomly selected items and abilities to purchase.
Items purchased are delivered at the start of the following night.
You may gift purchased items to any player.
Once per game, you may reroll the shop for free.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Delirious" until the next night.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
See also: Sailor (Village), Succubus (Cult).
Once per game at dusk, you can choose to change the target of a condemnation.
You cannot change the target to no one.
You cannot change the target of a condemnation on a Mafia-aligned player.
Choosing no one or the original target preserves your override ability.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and swap their visitors.
Players who visit first player will be redirected to second player.
Players who visit second player will be redirected to first player.
See also: Chauffeur (Village).

Drunk: If a Drunk blocks a Driver, The Driver dies.

description: Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
Each night, you can choose to redirect that player's visits on to another player. (Not a visit)
See also: Witch (Cult).
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and redirect anyone who visits the first player to the second player.
You do not visit when performing the mafia kill.
You can kill players holding Bombs without setting off the explosion.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them the only member to act in any group actions they are apart of.
The Mafia kill is a group action.
While you are alive, the Mafia's kill is replaced with a Coronation meeting.
One player is picked to be King for the next day. Their vote is worth 10000 votes.
You cannot pick the same player to be King twice in a row.
Upon your death, the Mafia reverts to killing.
While you are alive, the Mafia gain a day meeting.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them appear as an opposing vanilla role to information roles.

description: Once per game at night, you must choose a player.
You will instantly convert to that player's role.
You cannot win as Doppelgänger.
If killed by another player, you gain the ability: Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them.
You do not gain the ability if condemned by village vote.
You win if you are killed and all of your killers are dead.

Assassin: If an Assassin is Present, a Vengeful Spirit will win at the end of the game if they are dead and no Presidents, Senators, or Vital Village roles are dead.

description: Each night, each player who visits you becomes "Wrapped".
If condemned, you will gain the ability: Once per game at night, you can choose to revive yourself and kill all "Wrapped" players.
You win if you are alive in final 2.
Once per game at night, you can choose to visit one player and convert to their role and kill them.
Players killed by you only have their alignment revealed.
You cannot win as Phantom.
Each night, you must choose to visit one player and become their alignment.
You do not learn your new alignment.
You cannot choose to visit the same player consecutively.
You win if your current alignment wins.
Each night, one player who visits you will become "Delirious" and you will become their alignment.
Players who are "Delirious" will only learn false information with their abilities and will have their non-information abilities disabled.
You will start the game Village-aligned.
You win if your current alignment wins.
On your first night, you must choose to visit one player and give them a Doll.
Players with the Doll can pass it to someone else each night.
You win if a player holding the Doll dies.
You are always assigned to the first player(s) in the list.
Village cannot win until a Host stops hosting.
You can only die if you choose to stop hosting.
Whispers to or from a Host will not leak.
Cannot be added to ranked or competitive games.
Before the game starts the Host can assign you a role.
You win if the Host chooses for you to win.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Fishing Rod.
Fishing Rods can be used to play a terrible fishing mini-game instead of Mafia.
Each night, you can choose to visit a player and become immune to death unless that player visits you.
If that player visits you, you die and that player will gain an extra life.
You win if alive at the end of the game.
On your first night, you must choose to visit two players and make them "Lovesick" for each other.
Players who are "Lovesick" for another player, will die if that player dies.
You win if your chosen lovers are alive at the end of the game.
You win if alive at the end of the game and Village has not won.
At the beginning of the game, one player randomly receives a Notebook.
A player holding a Notebook can kill a selected player during the night.
A player holding a Notebook must pass it to another player each day.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and win if they are holding a Notebook.
You are assigned an Independent player as a target.
You meet with your target at night.
If your target is killed or converted, you convert to their role.
You win if your target wins.
Each night, you invite all Independent players to an anonymous Villain meeting.
You win if you are the only Independent player alive.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and protect them from death until the following night.
If a player you protect is attacked, you gain 1 point.
Your vote weight is worth 0 votes.
You win if you have 2 points, or if no deaths happen in 2 days and 2 nights.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
If that player is condemned the next day, you gain 1 point.
If you visit no one and no one is condemned, you gain 1 point.
You win if you get 2 points.

Assassin: If an Assassin is Present, The Warlock wins if they can guess a player who is Elected as Room Leader Twice.
Blood Moon: During the Blood Moon Event, The Warlock wins if they predict the condemnation correctly Once.

description: You win if you survive and all other rivals are dead.
Adds 1 Rival in closed setups.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn if they are Mafia.
When you have visited all the living mafia, you are converted into a random mafia role.
You cannot win as Picciotto.
You are assigned a random player as a target.
Once per game while alive or dead at night, you can choose to protect your target from death until the following night.
If your target is attacked when protected, you die.
You win if your target is alive at the end of the game.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players.
During the following day, only those two players may be voted.
Each night, you must choose one of the two players to be your champion.
If your champion survives the following day, you gain 1 point.
You win if you have 2 points.
No Evil roles will be present in the game.
At night, you will passively and randomly kill players and use abilities of Evil roles that can spawn in the setup.
Some information and role reveals may be falsified, and your own flips can appear as an Evil role.
If Village declares Magus Game and a Magus is not present, all Village-aligned players die.
Village must declare a Magus game to win.
Village and you lose if only 2 players are alive.
You win if Village wins.
You meet with all Independent roles.
You win if Independents have majority.
Lone Independents do not meet or count for majority.

Blood Moon: During the Blood Moon Event, Superheros Wins if no Independents die and non-Lone Independents are counted as an Evil Faction for Village.

description: Each night, you must choose to visit one player and kill them.
You win if you are alive in the final two.
On your first night, you must choose to visit one player and become "Lovesick" for them.
Players who are "Lovesick" for another player, will die if that player dies.
Each night, you must choose to visit one player and kill them.
You win if only you and players you are "Lovesick" for are alive.
You have a clock that starts at 6 o'clock.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them.
Your clock goes up by 1 hour for killing Village roles, 2 hours for killing Mafia or Cult roles, and down by 3 hours for killing Independent roles.
If your clock strikes 3 o'clock, you die.
If your clock strikes 9 o'clock, you gain an extra life.
You win when your clock strikes 12 o'clock or if you are alive in the final two.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and make them "Doused".
Each day, you can choose to kill all players that are "Doused".
You win if you are alive in the final two.
Once per game at night, you can choose Independent role from the setup.
You will be converted to that role.
This choice happens before other night actions, and you use the new role that same night.
If another player is that role, that player will be converted to Amnesiac.
You cannot win the game as Egg.
Each night, you choose a role.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them if their role is the selected role.
If you kill a player, you will be protected from death the following day.
If that player's role is not the chosen role, you will be revealed to all.
You win if Hellhounds have majority.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them and hide their role.
Players you kill meet with you.
For every two players you kill, you gain an extra life.
If you die, all players you killed are revived.
You win if you are alive in the final two.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and die, then convert that player to Grey Goo.
You win if a Grey Goo is alive in the final two.
You meet with the Mafia and Cult.
You anonymizes the Mafia and Cult meetings.
You count toward Mafia/Cult majority.
If the Mafia or Cult wins, you win instead.
You meet with the Mafia and Cult.
You anonymize the Mafia and Cult meetings.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and if the player is sided with the Mafia/Cult convert them to Mafioso/Cultist.
You win if all Mafia-aligned players are Mafiosos or all Cult-aligned players are Cultists.
You meet with the Mafia and Cult but do not act with them.
You anonymize the Mafia and Cult meetings.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them.
You win if you are alive in the final two and all Mafia and Cult are dead.
You meet with other Aliens at night.
Each night, all Aliens can choose to visit one player and probe them.
You win if all alive players have been probed.
Each night, you can choose to visit two players and if they are the same alignment, they will become "Starstruck".
You win if all alive players are "Starstruck".
Adds the Famine event to the setup.
You are immune to the famine.
If you die, each remaining player loses one food.
You appear as Turkey to information roles.
You win if only Turkeys and Tofurkeys are alive.
Adds the Famine event to the setup.
You are immune to the famine.
If you die, each remaining player gets given a food.
You win if only Turkeys and Tofurkeys are alive.
At the beginning of the game, some players randomly receive clovers.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and steal a random item from them, preferentially stealing Clovers.
You win if you are holding three Clovers.

Leprechaun: If a Leprechaun visits another Leprechaun, they will steal all their items and kill them.

description: Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Timebomb.
A Timebomb can be passed around during the day, it will explode after 10-30 seconds.
If you kill a player with a timebomb, you gain a point.
You win if you are alive in the final two or if you have 3 points.
Your Timebomb will reveal you if it explodes on you.
You meet with other Communists at night.
Each night, all Communists can choose to visit one player and convert them to their alignment's vanilla role.
You win if all other players are vanilla.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and give them a Revolver.

A Revolver has 6 chambers one of which has full. A Revolver must be used during the day to fire the selected chamber or a random chamber. Then pass it to another player if the chamber was empty or die if the chamber was full.
If you kill a player with a revolver, you gain a point.
You win if you are alive in the final two or if you have 3 points.
Your Revolver will reveal you if it shoots you.
On your first night, you must choose a sequence of numbers.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player.
The following day, that player must guess the number sequence.
If that player guesses incorrectly they die and all players are given a hint.
Pico if the guess contained a correct digit.
Fermi if the guess contained a correct digit in the correct location.
Bagel if the guess contained no correct digits.
You can only die if and only if your number sequence is correctly guessed.
You win if you are alive in the final two.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and challenge them to a game of Rock, Paper, Scissors the following day.
If you win the game of Rock, Paper, Scissors, that player dies and you gain 1 point.
You win if you are alive in the final two or if you have 2 points.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill each player who visits that player.
If no one visits that player, you kill them.
You win if you are alive in the final two.
You meet with other Polar Bears at night.
Each night, all Polar Bears can choose to visit two players and make them "Polarised".
Players who are "Polarised" will die if they visit or get visited by another "Polarised".
A polarised player visiting another polarised player will kill both of them.
You win if four polarised players die or if majority is attained.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and kill them if they visit you.
If you kill a player, you gain a point.
You win if you are alive in the final two or if you have 2 points.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and duel them in turn based combat mini-game.
You and that player have the option to use four moves during the duel:
Attack - Deals damage. There is a chance to Crit for double damage.
Defend - Grants Block. Block will absorb damage.
Focus - Raises Attack Power, Block Power, or Crit Chance at random
Charge - Strengthens the duelist's next move. Charging multiple times will allow for special moves to be used.
You win if you win your duel.
Each night, you may declare a snowball fight.
During a snowball fight, half of all players will receive a Snowball.
Snowballs can be used during the day to make a player "Frozen".
Players who are "Frozen" cannot vote or will have their night actions blocked. If a "Frozen" player is visited, they will stop being "Frozen".
You win if all living players have been frozen.
You can anonymously broadcast messages during the day.
Twice per game during the day, you can choose for a court session to happen at dusk.
During a court session an additional player can be condemned and all voting and speaking is anonymous.
Your vote counts for three during a Court session.
You win if you are alive in the final two.
Each night, you can choose to visit one player and learn their role and attach strings to them.
Each night, you can choose to redirect the visits of each player you have attached strings to, on to other players. (Not a visit)
You win if you are alive in the final two.
Before the game starts, you are replaced with a random Banished Independent role.
Before the game starts, you are replaced with a random Banished role.
If this Event occurs, one random player will be given a random item.
The item can be a Gun, Armor, Bomb, Knife, Crystal Ball, Whiskey, Bread, Key, Falcon, Tract, Envelope, Syringe, Coffee, Shield, or Candle.
If this Event has item-giving modifiers, it gives those items instead of a random item. Multiple modifiers give multiple items.
If this event occurs, one player receives a Haunted Mask.
Only the player with the Haunted Mask is informed if this event occurs.
Players being attacked are prioritized for receiving the Mask.
If a player with a Haunted Mask is attacked, they will kill their attacker and steal their identity.
If this event occurs, each player will be assigned another player.
Each player will choose an item for their assigned player to receive.
Can only occur if an alive player has a Vanilla role.
If this Event occurs, one random player with a Vanilla role will be converted to a random role from their alignment.
If this Event occurs, all players will have a random modifier added to their role.
If this Event occurs, the next Day phase is skipped.
This Event can only occur once.
If this Event occurs, one player will get to learn another player's role during the Day.
If this Event occurs, all players will be blocked and forced to vote on a player to kill and eat during the Night.
If this Event occurs, all players gain food.
If this Event occurs, all players lose food. If they have no food to lose, they die.
If this Event is in a setup, all players start with 1 Food.
If this Event occurs, all players will become "Blind".
Players who are "Blind" will see all speech as anonymous and cannot see votes.
If this Event occurs, all players will become "Foggy".
Players who are "Foggy" can only see their neighbors messages and votes.
If this Event occurs, all players are Frustrated for 1 day.
Frustrated players cannot be condemned by majority vote. A non-zero minority vote will kill a frustrated player.
If this Event occurs, all players will become "Paralyzed".
Players who are "Paralyzed" cannot switch votes.
If this Event occurs, all players will have their night actions blocked.
If this Event occurs, all players will be protected from death.
If this Event occurs, 1-3 Players learn if their role changed.
If this Event occurs, all players learn that a player is 1 of 3 roles.
One of the roles is always Evil.
If this Event occurs, each players learn 3 excess roles instantly.
Evil players will always learn village roles.
If this Event occurs, 3 players can attend the opera.
Players attending the opera learn how many evil players are attending the opera.
1 player in attendance will learn the wrong number.
If this Event occurs, one player gains the ability to role share today.
If this Event occurs, all players gain Kites.
Kites can be used to kill a random player with the same alignment as the user.
If this Event occurs, a random player will die every 30 seconds until the day ends.
If this Event occurs, the game will end with a no-win scenario if nobody dies during the day.
This is unaffected by win-con altering abilities.
This event is the default endgame event, triggered by failing to kill or condemn after 3 continuous phases (by default).
If this Event occurs, the game will end in 5 minutes
No one wins if the game doesn't end before the 5 minutes are up.
This is unaffected by Win-con altering abilities.
If this Event occurs, the game will end the following day.
If all Mafia survive, Mafia wins.
If all Cult survive, Cult wins.
If at least 1 member from each Evil faction is killed, Village wins.
If this Event occurs, Cult gains the Necronomicon.
Cult may vote on which player holds the Necronomicon during at Day.
Players with the Necronomicon may choose a player to kill at Night.
